Name: Cloudburst
Components: V, S, M (a finely crushed quartz crystal)
Description: You cause clouds to gather, and a heavy rain begins to fall in a 150-foot-radius centered on a point you can see within range. The spell fails if cast indoors, underground, underwater, or in extremely hot and dry climates. For the duration: The area is lightly obscured. Any unprotected flames are extinguished. Soft earth becomes muddy difficult terrain. The water created by the spell does not quench thirst or provide any nourishment to plants. After the spell ends, the rainwater quickly evaporates, leaving no trace of itself after 1 minute.
